items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Matty doubled on the viola, he had a viola he liked to play

ctx.x: A little outside of the place, so anyway I worked with Hoag and he sits down and sings it over three times and then I figure I got to get a combination on it, to put behind it. I didn't want to put the whole band in it, so I got something down there, you know, no cello or

anything, I got the bass clarinet, and all the clarinets and strings and Matty doubled on the viola, he had a viola he liked to play, so Hoagy plays the thing over and sings it and I put down the accompaniment pretty much the way he plays it, fills it out a little bit.

And then there's Jimmy and Tommy and Bix and Steve. Oh, by this time I had talked to Paul, "How about Steve? I think he'd be good in the band." Steve wasn't the best reader in the world and for all the faking he did, who knows what you're going to do if he played the tune often enough, he's got the part pretty well figured out. But to bow, things like that, which maybe that required, Mike Trafficante was playing the fiddle then, switched over to tuba and that would allow -- Steve also played tuba so the two of…
